Name: Speed Rooster
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]Speed Rooster[/b]
Adds the option to purchase the Speed Rooster from Marnie’s Ranch after attending the Desert Festival.
This animal costs 1200g and produces Rooster Feathers daily, with a chance to produce Roosters foots as a deluxe product.

[b][u]Main Features[/u][/b]
• [b]New Farm Animal:[/b] Adds the Speed Rooster as a purchasable animal at Marnie’s Ranch
◦ Becomes available after attending the Desert Festival
◦ Costs 1200g

• [b]Animal Products:[/b]
◦ Produces Rooster Feathers every day
◦ Has a chance to produce Rooster Feet as a deluxe product

Manifest.Name: Speed Rooster
